_why: Task 1 mutation contracts, anchored at Phase 5e against the authoritative scanner and consumers.

mutations.name: tag-check-removed
mutations._mechanism: `extract` returns every ```bash fence, tagged or not

mutations.name: fence-run-length-ignored
mutations._mechanism: any ``` line closes a fence, regardless of run length

mutations.name: section-bound-ignores-level
mutations._mechanism: the section ends at the next heading of *any* level

mutations.name: heading-lookalike-accepted
mutations._mechanism: heading recognition is loosened to `line.lstrip().startswith("#")`, so `#hashtag`, a 7-`#` run or a 4-space-indented `## x` bounds or starts a section

mutations.name: adjacent-heading-skipped
mutations._mechanism: the boundary predicate becomes `>` `start` instead of `≥`, so a same-or-shallower heading on the very next line after the requested heading is not a boundary and its tagged block is extracted under the wrong address

mutations.name: heading-level-pin-ignored
mutations._mechanism: `find_heading` matches the full `## Text` form on text alone, ignoring the hash count

mutations.name: request-predicate-space-only
mutations._mechanism: the full-form request predicate accepts only a space after the hash run while the scanner accepts a space, a tab or end of line, so `##\tText` and `##` requests fall to the bare form and cannot select their headings
mutations.find: full = request is not None and request.kind == "heading"
mutations.replace: full = request is not None and request.kind == "heading" and heading.lstrip(" ").lstrip("#").startswith(" ")

mutations.name: form-precedence-bare-first
mutations._mechanism: `find_heading` tries the bare form first (or unions both forms), so the request `## Text` also matches a `### ## Text` heading and refuses as ambiguous
mutations.find:
if event.kind == "heading" and event.text == title
               and (not full or event.level == request.level)

mutations.name: closing-hash-run-kept
mutations._mechanism: `_fence_events` leaves the optional closing hash run in a heading event's text, so `## Text ##` no longer matches `## Text` and a `## Text`/`## Text ##` pair counts as one

mutations.name: heading-match-ignores-fence-state
mutations._mechanism: the heading search runs over every line instead of the scanner's `heading` events, so a fenced `## <heading>` starts the section
mutations.replace: matches = [event for line in text.splitlines(keepends=True) for event in _fence_events(line)

mutations.name: duplicate-heading-takes-first
mutations._mechanism: `AmbiguousHeading` never raised; first match wins

mutations.name: select-first-on-ambiguous
mutations._mechanism: `select` returns `blocks[0]` when >1 and no index

mutations.name: index-below-one-accepted
mutations._mechanism: `index < 1` reaches `blocks[index - 1]`

mutations.name: duplicate-info-token-last-wins
mutations._mechanism: a repeated recognised token overwrites instead of refusing

mutations.name: doc-decode-error-unwrapped
mutations._mechanism: the document read drops `UnicodeDecodeError` from the `DocUnreadable` wrap (or reads with `errors="replace"`)

mutations.name: unknown-info-key-ignored
mutations._mechanism: an unrecognised token falls back to strict
mutations.find: if token not in ("hmad:exec", "shell=strict", "shell=plain") or key in seen:

mutations.name: scanner-duplicated-in-consumer
mutations._mechanism: `extract` regrows a private fence toggle instead of consuming `_fence_events`
mutations.replace: if event.kind == "open" and event.marker == "`" and event.info.split()[:1] == ["bash"]:

mutations.name: closer-trailing-text-accepted
mutations._mechanism: a line whose marker run is followed by non-blank text closes the fence

mutations.name: body-indent-not-stripped
mutations._mechanism: `extract` returns fence body lines with the opener's indentation still on them

mutations.name: indented-opener-accepted
mutations._mechanism: a run preceded by 4+ spaces is treated as an opener

mutations.name: prefix-state-truncated-mid-line
mutations._mechanism: the prefix is fed as `text[:start]` instead of whole lines through the line containing `start`, so a ```` ```trailing ```` line cut after its run reads as a closer

mutations.name: prefix-fence-state-skipped
mutations._mechanism: `fence_aware_end` starts its fence state at `start` instead of scanning the lines before it

mutations.name: backtick-in-info-accepted
mutations._mechanism: `_fence_events` treats a backtick-fence line whose info string contains a backtick as an opener
mutations.find: if match and not (match["marks"][0] == "`" and "`" in match["info"]):

mutations.name: tilde-fence-not-tracked
mutations._mechanism: `~~~` fences are not tracked, so a heading inside one ends a section and a quoted ```bash opener inside one is a candidate

mutations.name: indented-closer-accepted
mutations._mechanism: the scanner closes a fence on a marker run preceded by four or more spaces
